parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to obtain the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou:** the Chinese mainland
*   **ap-southeast-1:** outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: SearchType
parameters.description:
The type of the query condition. Valid values:

*   **id:** queries regular expression rule groups by ID.
*   **name:** queries regular expression rule groups by name.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-rule-groups --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --search-type name --search-value test --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeRuleGroups --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --PageSize 10 --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --PageNumber 1 --SearchValue test --SearchType name --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
